reuse.why: Correctly hooks into the existing shouldFillCategory predicate used by every month-wide action, but detects the tag with a hand-written regex instead of the shared tag parsing in shared/tags.ts (extractTagsFromText), which defines how tags are delimited and escaped in notes.

duplication.why: The fixed-group rule is written once; the same notes join is added to both category queries (following the tree's existing two-query pattern) and the tag regex re-implements tag recognition.

placement.why: The new exclusion sits in shouldFillCategory in budget/actions.ts alongside the hidden and template exclusions.

scope.why: Only the predicate, its helper and the two queries feeding it change.

maintainability.why: Easy to follow, but the private regex can drift from how the rest of the app recognises tags (e.g. '##fixed' escaping, '#'-delimited tags).

bypasses_abstraction.where: isFixedGroup in budget/actions.ts parses the #fixed tag itself instead of using extractTagsFromText from shared/tags.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: The tag regex is a re-implementation, not a reshaped copy of existing code.

one_place.where: shouldFillCategory in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, used by setZero, copyPreviousMonth and the bulk average/spending actions.
